issues.title: Missing Cross-Language Parent Reference
issues.why: AC-SD-01 explicitly inherits rules from '../02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/97-acceptance-criteria.md', but this file is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include the cross-language AC file in the module context or inline the specific inherited rules.

issues.title: Incomplete Quota Enforcement Logic
issues.why: AC-SD-17 mandates blocking writes at 100% quota, but does not specify if this check is performed at the application level or via SQLite triggers/hooks.
issues.fix: Specify that the DbManager must check file size before BEGIN IMMEDIATE or use a SQLite max_page_count limit.

issues.title: Ambiguous Sequence Number Assignment
issues.why: AC-SD-05 requires sequence numbers to be assigned by the Root DB registry but doesn't specify if they are global or per-category.
issues.fix: Clarify that SequenceNum is incremented per (ApplicationId, Category, SubCategory) tuple in the Counter table.
